knowledge_gaps: The proposed curriculum lacks a constant-0.8 control. Comparing only against constant-0.5 weighting cannot distinguish a curriculum effect from increased terminal supervision. The 0.8 endpoint and halfway ramp are unvalidated choices.

Sampling is underspecified: uniform endpoints per sampled user differs from uniform sampling over all training endpoints. Minimum prefix length, branch batch sizes, interior masking rate, empty-supervision handling, and exact baseline loss must be documented.
The report needs a compute allocation and checkpoint-selection schedule within 43,200 GPU-seconds. Two branch passes could increase training cost unless the original total batch size is partitioned.

Aggregated training margins do not identify which branch needs improvement. Report terminal and interior margins separately on fixed diagnostic examples; changing their mixture otherwise changes the measurement itself.

Terminal alignment does not directly establish better recency modeling, preference conjunctions, or compatibility. Uniform endpoint sampling is not recency sampling, and these user-facing mechanisms remain untested.

Originality 4 is defensible as incremental adaptation. Potential 7 is speculative; difficulty 2 describes loss weighting alone and understates sampler auditing, serialization repair, and diagnostic integration.
